name: Altstadt (Old Town)
tagline: Storybook squares north of the river
description: Lucerne's medieval heart sits north of the Reuss, a maze of car-free lanes, painted facades and frescoed squares beneath the Musegg Wall towers. Steps from the Chapel Bridge, it is the most atmospheric place to stay, full of cafes, shops and history, though small and busy with visitors.
bestFor: First-time nomads who want charm and central walkability
pros: Everything on foot, no car needed
Cafes, shops and sights on the doorstep
cons: Very touristy and can feel crowded

name: Lakefront and Station Area
tagline: Trains, boats and lake views south of the river
description: South of the Reuss around the main railway station and the lakefront, this is Lucerne's modern, connected side. It holds the culture and convention centre, boat piers, hotels and the transport hub, blending easy access with grand promenade views over the lake toward the mountains.
bestFor: Nomads who value transport links and lake views
pros: Major rail hub and boat piers at hand
Close to culture venues and dining
cons: Busy and heavily trafficked by visitors
Some of the highest prices in the city

name: Wesemlin / Maihof
tagline: Quiet residential hillside above the centre
description: Northeast of the old town, Wesemlin and Maihof are calm, leafy residential districts where locals actually live. Set on gentle slopes with views, they offer a quieter, more everyday feel while staying a short bus ride or walk from the centre, making them a practical base for a longer stay.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting quiet and a neighbourhood feel
pros: Short hop to the centre by bus
cons: Still expensive, like all of Lucerne

name: Kriens
tagline: At the foot of Mount Pilatus
description: Just southwest of Lucerne and linked by frequent transport, Kriens sits at the base of Mount Pilatus, with the panorama gondola climbing from town. It is a more residential, slightly better-value suburb that keeps you close to the city while putting hiking and mountain access right on your doorstep.
bestFor: Outdoor lovers wanting mountain access and better value
pros: Slightly better value than the centre
Well connected to Lucerne by transport
cons: Less charm than the old town
Further from lakefront nightlife and sights
